name: Flavor Full Foods Inc.
summary: Flavor Full Foods Inc. is dedicated to the manufacturing and international distribution of a wide array of sesame-derived and other edible oil products. Operating both domestically in Taiwan and across global markets, the company offers a comprehensive selection of oils, including pure, extra premium toasted, blended, black, ginger, garlic, stir-fry, shallot, cold-pressed, and hot sesame oils, as well as crude soybean and corn oils. Beyond its core oil offerings, Flavor Full Foods Inc. also produces pure white, black, and traditional sesame sauces, black sesame spreads, tahini, and sesame salad dressing. Their product line further extends to various sesame seed forms, such as roasted raw black, white, and hulled seeds, along with flavored options, sesame stuffing, and sesame protein and extract powder. These items are primarily marketed under the well-known FOREWAY brand, and the company also supplies SESANOOD products. The firm, headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, was established in 1965. It was originally known as Chien Fa Edible Oil Manufactory before officially changing its name to Flavor Full Foods Inc. in 1983.
